summary: vanexa-agent daemon exposes local shell/exec via hardcoded Cloudflare Workers relay
details: The package ships a long-running 'AI agent' daemon (dist/bundle.cjs) that connects out to hardcoded Cloudflare Workers endpoints at https://vanexa-agent-relay.workers.dev and https://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev and dispatches received messages into local child_process spawn/exec sinks, giving whoever controls those Workers a path to run arbitrary commands, read/write files, and drive code generation on the host running the daemon. The README advertises LAN-only phone-to-PC pairing, but the bundled code unconditionally reaches these remote relays; multiple outbound POSTs are present in the bundle (dist/bundle.cjs lines 221, 291, 432, 1151). The relay subdomain 'hanazaki542.workers.dev' is owned by a different identity than the npm publisher scope '@ikbal_fadilah_vanexa01', so control of the command channel does not sit with the package publisher.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
